**Purpose**: Establish the full method at a glance. Supports Claim 3 (CodeQL pipeline practicality) and orients the reader for §3.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fig 4: Representation Geometry — 2-panel figure for StructFuse paper."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
strategies = ['Random', 'Embedding', 'Dataflow']

data = {
    'Qwen2.5-Coder-3B': {
        'pos_sim':      [0.9855, 0.9855, 0.9856],
        'neg_sim':      [0.9111, 0.9685, 0.9563],
        'margin':       [0.0743, 0.0170, 0.0293],
        'margin_std':   [0.2322, 0.1140, 0.1407],
        'pct_positive': [81.8,   58.8,   73.9],
    },
    'StarCoder2-3B': {
        'pos_sim':      [0.7985, 0.8079, 0.8009],
        'neg_sim':      [0.6045, 0.7409, 0.6818],
        'margin':       [0.1940, 0.0670, 0.1192],
        'margin_std':   [0.2788, 0.2056, 0.2264],
        'pct_positive': [78.0,   55.0,   70.4],
    },
}

# ── Style ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'Times', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 8.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 9.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 7.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'xtick.major.size': 3,
    'ytick.major.size': 3,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

# Colorblind-friendly: blue for Qwen, orange for StarCoder
c_qwen = '#4477AA'
c_star = '#EE7733'
c_qwen_light = '#88BBDD'
c_star_light = '#FFBB78'

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, (ax_a, ax_b) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.0, 2.8),
                                  gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1, 1.15], 'wspace': 0.35})

# ── Panel (a): Margin Comparison ─────────────────────────────────────────────
x = np.arange(len(strategies))
bar_w = 0.32

bars_q = ax_a.bar(x - bar_w/2, data['Qwen2.5-Coder-3B']['margin'], bar_w,
                  yerr=data['Qwen2.5-Coder-3B']['margin_std'],
                  color=c_qwen, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.4,
                  error_kw=dict(lw=0.7, capsize=2.5, capthick=0.7),
                  label='Qwen2.5-Coder-3B', zorder=3)
bars_s = ax_a.bar(x + bar_w/2, data['StarCoder2-3B']['margin'], bar_w,
                  yerr=data['StarCoder2-3B']['margin_std'],
                  color=c_star, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.4,
                  error_kw=dict(lw=0.7, capsize=2.5, capthick=0.7),
                  label='StarCoder2-3B', zorder=3)

# Ratio annotations
ratios = [2.61, 3.94, 4.07]
for i, r in enumerate(ratios):
    y_top = data['StarCoder2-3B']['margin'][i] + data['StarCoder2-3B']['margin_std'][i] + 0.012
    ax_a.annotate(f'{r:.1f}×', xy=(x[i], y_top), fontsize=6.5,
                  ha='center', va='bottom', color='#555555',
                  fontweight='medium')

ax_a.set_ylabel('Margin (pos − neg similarity)')
ax_a.set_xticks(x)
ax_a.set_xticklabels(strategies)
ax_a.set_ylim(0, 0.52)
ax_a.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(0.1))
ax_a.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, fancybox=False,
            edgecolor='#cccccc', framealpha=0.95)
ax_a.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_a.yaxis.grid(True, linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.5)
ax_a.text(-0.12, 1.04, '(a)', transform=ax_a.transAxes,
          fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ── Panel (b): Similarity Distribution (box-style comparison) ────────────────
# Visualize neg_sim ranges with pos_sim reference lines
# Use a grouped layout: for each strategy, show Qwen and StarCoder neg_sim as
# boxes (mean ± std) with pos_sim as a marker

encoders = ['Qwen2.5-Coder-3B', 'StarCoder2-3B']
colors = [c_qwen, c_star]
labels_enc = ['Qwen2.5-Coder-3B', 'StarCoder2-3B']

group_positions = np.arange(len(strategies))
offsets = [-0.18, 0.18]
box_w = 0.28

for ei, (enc, col) in enumerate(zip(encoders, colors)):
    for si, strat in enumerate(strategies):
        pos = group_positions[si] + offsets[ei]
        neg_mean = data[enc]['neg_sim'][si]
        neg_std = data[enc]['margin_std'][si]
        pos_sim = data[enc]['pos_sim'][si]

        # Neg similarity range box (mean ± 0.5*std to show typical spread)
        box_lo = neg_mean - 0.5 * neg_std
        box_hi = neg_mean + 0.5 * neg_std
        whisker_lo = neg_mean - neg_std
        whisker_hi = min(neg_mean + neg_std, 1.0)

        # Box
        ax_b.bar(pos, box_hi - box_lo, box_w, bottom=box_lo,
                 color=col, alpha=0.35, edgecolor=col, linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
        # Median line (neg_sim mean)
        ax_b.hlines(neg_mean, pos - box_w/2, pos + box_w/2,
                     colors=col, linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
        # Whiskers
        ax_b.vlines(pos, whisker_lo, box_lo, colors=col, linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
        ax_b.vlines(pos, box_hi, whisker_hi, colors=col, linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
        ax_b.hlines(whisker_lo, pos - box_w/4, pos + box_w/4,
                     colors=col, linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
        ax_b.hlines(whisker_hi, pos - box_w/4, pos + box_w/4,
                     colors=col, linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)

        # Pos_sim reference marker
        ax_b.plot(pos, pos_sim, marker='D', markersize=3.5, color=col,
                  markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.4, zorder=5)

# Ceiling effect annotation
ax_b.annotate('ceiling\neffect', xy=(-0.18, 0.97), fontsize=6, color=c_qwen,
              ha='center', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic',
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_qwen, lw=0.6),
              xytext=(-0.45, 1.04))

# Add a shaded region for Qwen saturation zone
ax_b.axhspan(0.90, 1.02, color=c_qwen, alpha=0.04, zorder=1)
ax_b.text(2.65, 0.955, 'Qwen\nsaturation\nzone', fontsize=5.5, color=c_qwen,
          alpha=0.7, ha='left', va='center', fontstyle='italic')

ax_b.set_ylabel('Cosine similarity')
ax_b.set_xticks(group_positions)
ax_b.set_xticklabels(strategies)
ax_b.set_ylim(0.45, 1.08)
ax_b.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(0.1))
ax_b.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_b.yaxis.grid(True, linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.5)

# Custom legend for panel (b)
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor=c_qwen, alpha=0.35, edgecolor=c_qwen, label='Qwen neg sim'),
    Patch(facecolor=c_star, alpha=0.35, edgecolor=c_star, label='StarCoder neg sim'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='D', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray',
           markersize=4, label='pos sim (ref)'),
]
ax_b.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower left', frameon=True,
            fancybox=False, edgecolor='#cccccc', framealpha=0.95)
ax_b.text(-0.12, 1.04, '(b)', transform=ax_b.transAxes,
          fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir = Path(__file__).parent
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'fig4_rep_geometry.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'fig4_rep_geometry.png', format='png', dpi=300)
plt.close(fig)
print(f"Saved to {out_dir / 'fig4_rep_geometry.pdf'}")
print(f"Saved to {out_dir / 'fig4_rep_geometry.png'}")

"""Fig 1: StructFuse Pipeline Overview — from input to fine-tuned retriever."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Rectangle
from pathlib import Path

# ── Style ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'Times', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette (consistent with Fig 4)
C_RANDOM = '#E69F00'
C_EMBED  = '#0072B2'
C_DFAW   = '#009E73'
C_BG     = '#F7F7F7'
C_BORDER = '#999999'
C_ARROW  = '#555555'
C_TEXT   = '#333333'
C_SUB    = '#777777'
C_NOTE   = '#AAAAAA'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.0, 2.8))
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 10.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.2, 4.2)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def rbox(cx, cy, w, h, fc=C_BG, ec=C_BORDER, lw=0.8, ls='-', alpha=1.0, zorder=2, pad=0.1):
    p = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                        boxstyle=f'round,pad={pad}',
                        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec,
                        linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder)
    ax.add_patch(p)
    return p

def arr(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=C_ARROW, lw=1.0, rad=0):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),
                         arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=8, lw=lw, color=c,
                         connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}', zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(a)

def txt(x, y, s, fs=8, c=C_TEXT, fw='normal', ha='center', va='center', **kw):
    ax.text(x, y, s, fontsize=fs, color=c, fontweight=fw, ha=ha, va=va, zorder=5, **kw)

# ── Coordinates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y0 = 2.0

x_in  = 0.65;  w_in  = 1.0
x_cq  = 2.45;  w_cq  = 1.35
x_mn  = 5.0;   w_mn  = 1.75
x_tr  = 7.6;   w_tr  = 1.35
x_out = 9.45;  w_out = 1.0

bh = 1.05
dy = 0.72
sh = 0.42
am = 0.15

y_r = y0 + dy
y_e = y0
y_d = y0 - dy

# ── Block 1: Input ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rbox(x_in, y0, w_in, bh)
txt(x_in, y0 + 0.17, 'Repository', fs=7.5, fw='bold')
txt(x_in, y0 - 0.17, '+ Bug Report', fs=6.5, c=C_SUB)

# ── Block 2: CodeQL Extraction ───────────────────────────────────────────────
rbox(x_cq, y0, w_cq, bh)
txt(x_cq, y0 + 0.25, 'CodeQL', fs=9, fw='bold')
txt(x_cq, y0 - 0.05, 'Scope-bounded', fs=6, c=C_SUB)
txt(x_cq, y0 - 0.28, 'data-flow analysis', fs=6, c=C_SUB)

txt(x_cq, y0 - bh/2 - 0.25, 'Structural Graph G', fs=6.5, c=C_NOTE, fontstyle='italic')
txt(x_cq, y0 - bh/2 - 0.50, '(drift-immune)', fs=5.5, c=C_NOTE, fontstyle='italic')

# ── Block 3: Negative Mining ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
container_h = 2 * dy + sh + 0.55
rbox(x_mn, y0, w_mn + 0.3, container_h,
     fc='white', ec='#BBBBBB', lw=0.6, ls=(0, (4, 3)), alpha=0.4, zorder=1)
txt(x_mn, y0 + container_h/2 - 0.15, 'Negative Mining', fs=8, fw='bold', c=C_SUB)

strats = [
    ('Random',              C_RANDOM, y_r),
    ('Embedding-distance',  C_EMBED,  y_e),
    ('Dataflow-aware',      C_DFAW,   y_d),
]
for name, color, sy in strats:
    rbox(x_mn, sy, w_mn, sh, fc=color, ec=color, alpha=0.12, pad=0.06)
    accent = Rectangle((x_mn - w_mn/2 + 0.02, sy - sh/2 + 0.04), 0.06, sh - 0.08,
                         facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(accent)
    txt(x_mn + 0.05, sy, name, fs=7, c=color, fw='semibold')

# ── Block 4: Contrastive Training ────────────────────────────────────────────
rbox(x_tr, y0, w_tr, bh)
txt(x_tr, y0 + 0.22, 'Contrastive', fs=8, fw='bold')
txt(x_tr, y0 - 0.02, 'Training', fs=8, fw='bold')
txt(x_tr, y0 - 0.30, 'InfoNCE + LoRA', fs=6, c=C_SUB)

# ── Block 5: Output ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rbox(x_out, y0, w_out, bh)
txt(x_out, y0 + 0.14, 'Fine-tuned', fs=7.5, fw='bold')
txt(x_out, y0 - 0.14, 'Retriever', fs=7.5, fw='bold')

# ── Arrows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
arr(x_in + w_in/2 + am, y0, x_cq - w_cq/2 - am, y0)

x_cq_r = x_cq + w_cq/2 + am
x_mn_l = x_mn - w_mn/2 - am + 0.05
for name, color, sy in strats:
    rad = 0 if sy == y0 else (-0.12 if sy > y0 else 0.12)
    arr(x_cq_r, y0, x_mn_l, sy, c=color, lw=1.1, rad=rad)

x_mn_r = x_mn + w_mn/2 + am - 0.05
x_tr_l = x_tr - w_tr/2 - am
for name, color, sy in strats:
    rad = 0 if sy == y0 else (0.12 if sy > y0 else -0.12)
    arr(x_mn_r, sy, x_tr_l, y0, c=color, lw=1.1, rad=rad)

arr(x_tr + w_tr/2 + am, y0, x_out - w_out/2 - am, y0)

# ── Annotations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
txt(x_mn, y_d - sh/2 - 0.2, '66% fallback → embedding',
    fs=5.5, c=C_DFAW, fontstyle='italic')

txt(5.0, -0.05, 'Static mining — computed once, no re-mining during training',
    fs=6.5, c='#CCCCCC', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir = Path(__file__).parent
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'fig1_pipeline_overview.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'fig1_pipeline_overview.png', format='png', dpi=300)
plt.close(fig)
print(f"Saved: {out_dir / 'fig1_pipeline_overview.pdf'}")
print(f"Saved: {out_dir / 'fig1_pipeline_overview.png'}")

Only the negative selection (highlighted nodes) differs across panels,
illustrating how each strategy picks negatives.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

# ── Style (consistent with Fig 1 / Fig 4) ───────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'Times', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette (consistent across all figures)
C_RAND   = '#E69F00'   # orange — random strategy
C_EMBED  = '#0072B2'   # blue   — embedding-distance strategy
C_DFAW   = '#009E73'   # green  — dataflow-aware strategy
C_POS    = '#CC79A7'   # pink   — positive / gold file
C_GRAY   = '#E5E5E5'
C_GRAY_E = '#CCCCCC'
C_QUERY  = '#333333'
C_SUB    = '#888888'
C_EDGE   = '#CCCCCC'
C_EDGE_H = '#888888'
C_EXCL   = '#CC4444'

# ── Node Layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 10 nodes: 1 query + 9 files.  Distance from Q ≈ pretrained cosine similarity.
#
# Structural graph G edges: P–a, P–i  →  reachable from gold {P}: {a, i}
# Disconnected from gold:  {c, d, e, f, g, h}

nodes = {
    'Q':  (0.28, 0.48),
    'P':  (0.40, 0.67),
    'd':  (0.44, 0.43),   # closest non-gold, disconnected
    'i':  (0.18, 0.69),   # close, CONNECTED to P
    'a':  (0.46, 0.27),   # close, CONNECTED to P
    'c':  (0.42, 0.82),   # close, disconnected
    'e':  (0.64, 0.69),   # medium, disconnected
    'h':  (0.76, 0.50),   # medium-far, disconnected
    'f':  (0.10, 0.14),   # far, disconnected
    'g':  (0.86, 0.23),   # far, disconnected
}

struct_edges = [('P', 'a'), ('P', 'i')]
reachable = {'a', 'i'}

neg_sel = {
    'random':   {'f', 'g', 'h'},     # scattered, far → easy negatives
    'embed':    {'d', 'i', 'a'},     # top-3 closest non-gold → hard (i,a connected)
    'dataflow': {'d', 'c', 'e'},     # top-3 closest AMONG disconnected
}

NODE_R = 0.030


def _edge(ax, n1, n2, color, lw=0.8):
    (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = nodes[n1], nodes[n2]
    dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
    d = np.hypot(dx, dy)
    s = NODE_R * 1.5
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch(
        (x1 + dx / d * s, y1 + dy / d * s),
        (x2 - dx / d * s, y2 - dy / d * s),
        arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=7, lw=lw, color=color, zorder=1,
    ))


def _node(ax, x, y, fc, ec, lw=0.6, zorder=2):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((x, y), NODE_R, fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=zorder))


# ── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(7.0, 2.6))

panels = [
    ('(a) Random',             C_RAND,  'random',
     'negatives sampled uniformly'),
    ('(b) Embedding-Distance', C_EMBED, 'embed',
     'highest pretrained similarity to $q$'),
    ('(c) Dataflow-Aware',     C_DFAW,  'dataflow',
     'similar to $q$  +  structurally disconnected'),
]

for ax, (title, color, key, sub) in zip(axes, panels):
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, 1.02)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.axis('off')

    nset = neg_sel[key]
    ec = C_EDGE_H if key == 'dataflow' else C_EDGE
    ew = 1.3 if key == 'dataflow' else 0.8

    # ── structural (dataflow) edges ──────────────────────────────────────
    for s, t in struct_edges:
        _edge(ax, s, t, ec, ew)

    # ── embedding-distance circles (panel b only) ────────────────────────
    if key == 'embed':
        qx, qy = nodes['Q']
        for r, al in [(0.22, 0.18), (0.42, 0.10)]:
            ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((qx, qy), r, fill=False,
                                    ec=C_EMBED, lw=0.5, ls='--', alpha=al))
        ax.text(qx + 0.24, qy - 0.02, 'sim$(q, f)$', fontsize=5.5,
                color=C_EMBED, alpha=0.45, fontstyle='italic')

    # ── draw file nodes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    for name, (x, y) in nodes.items():
        if name == 'Q':
            ax.plot(x, y, '*', ms=15, color=C_QUERY,
                    mec='white', mew=0.3, zorder=5)
            ax.text(x, y - 0.062, '$q$', fontsize=7.5, ha='center',
                    va='top', color=C_QUERY, fontweight='bold')
        elif name == 'P':
            _node(ax, x, y, '#FDF0F5', C_POS, lw=1.6, zorder=3)
            ax.plot(x, y, 'D', ms=4, color=C_POS, zorder=4)
            ax.text(x + 0.05, y + 0.005, '$f^+$', fontsize=7,
                    color=C_POS, ha='left', va='center')
        elif name in nset:
            _node(ax, x, y, color, 'white', lw=0.6, zorder=3)
        else:
            _node(ax, x, y, C_GRAY, C_GRAY_E, lw=0.5)

    # ── exclusion marks (panel c): reachable nodes get ✕ ─────────────────
    if key == 'dataflow':
        for rn in reachable:
            rx, ry = nodes[rn]
            ax.plot(rx, ry, 'X', ms=8, color=C_EXCL, mew=1.4, zorder=6)
        ax.annotate('reachable\nvia $G$',
                    xy=(nodes['a'][0], nodes['a'][1] + 0.01),
                    xytext=(nodes['a'][0] + 0.12, nodes['a'][1] - 0.06),
                    fontsize=5, color=C_EXCL, fontstyle='italic',
                    ha='left', va='top',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_EXCL, lw=0.5))

    # ── title + subtitle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ax.text(0.5, 1.02, title, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5,
            fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='bottom')
    ax.text(0.5, -0.04, sub, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=5.5,
            ha='center', va='top', color=C_SUB, fontstyle='italic')

# ── Unified Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
handles = [
    Line2D([], [], marker='*', ls='None', color='w',
           mfc=C_QUERY, ms=10, label='Query ($q$)'),
    Line2D([], [], marker='D', ls='None', color='w',
           mfc=C_POS, ms=5, label='Positive ($f^+$)'),
    Line2D([], [], marker='o', ls='None', color='w',
           mfc='#999999', ms=6, label='Selected $f^-$'),
    Line2D([], [], marker='o', ls='None', color='w',
           mfc=C_GRAY, mec=C_GRAY_E, ms=6, label='Candidate file'),
    Line2D([], [], marker='>', color=C_EDGE_H, lw=1.0,
           ms=4, label='Dataflow edge'),
    Line2D([], [], marker='X', ls='None', color=C_EXCL,
           mew=1.2, ms=6, label='Excluded (reachable)'),
]
fig.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower center', ncol=6,
           frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor='#cccccc', framealpha=0.95,
           fontsize=6.5, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.02),
           handletextpad=0.3, columnspacing=1.0)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.10, 1, 0.97], w_pad=0.4)

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir = Path(__file__).parent
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'fig2_mining_strategies.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'fig2_mining_strategies.png', format='png', dpi=300)
plt.close(fig)
print(f"Saved: {out_dir / 'fig2_mining_strategies.pdf'}")
print(f"Saved: {out_dir / 'fig2_mining_strategies.png'}")
